title: Share Frames
tagline: Share Frames is a marketing tool for projects and content creators that want to scale in a Web3 world. Share Frames allow creators to collaborate with Web3 social media users in a win-win incentive program.
description: We developed a frame based affiliate marketing system that tracks re-shares and the subscriptions or sales that come through the re-shares. This allows projects and content creators to incentivize others to share their frames and get their product/service/content in front of more people.
how_its_made: Our system utilizes Next.js for the front-end application, which generates frames designed to assist individuals without technical expertise. Our tool offers a user-friendly platform for publishing your frames on Farcaster. To construct this tool, we leverage Base and Optimism as blockchain networks for NFT affiliation. Furthermore, we use Privy to streamline the onboarding process, and Frame.js serves as the engine for generating the frame content.
